title: Cybercrime and women: What gets counted?
description: During the Budget Session 2026–27, the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Empowerment of Women tabled the Fourth Report on Cyber Crimes and Cyber Safety of Women. The report identifies several facets of cybercrime ecosystem afflicting women in India, probes gaps in policy, and makes corresponding recommendations.  A primary concern with the report is the absence of cohesive and reliable public datasets.
